Name: Prompts_01_FirstSightGranary
overlord_bark: Their whole winter, stacked in one shed and very pleased with itself. Correct that.
hud_line: Burn the granary in the village core — one of your three burn targets; all three burning opens the portal home. Torch toss: Q.

Name: Prompts_02_FirstSightWheatField
overlord_bark: Ripe. Insultingly ripe. One spark, goblin, and it will spread the news for you.
hud_line: Burn the wheat field — a burn objective that spreads row to row and lights the map for a mile. Torch toss: Q.

Name: Prompts_03_FirstSightWindmill
overlord_bark: Fire on her sails is theatre. The dust in her belly is the murder. Aim better.
hud_line: Burn the windmill — torch the frame for Stage 1: Ablaze, then throw fire through a window to detonate the grain dust and finish the objective. Torch toss: Q (aimed).

Name: Prompts_04_FirstSightPatrol
overlord_bark: Torches in the trees. Let them look, little one. A look is not a seeing.
hud_line: Break their line of sight — a sighting needs about 1.5 seconds to confirm, and staying unconfirmed until the first fire earns First Spark Unseen. Stealth stance: Crouch.

Name: Prompts_05_FirstSightCivilianTakedown
overlord_bark: From behind. Quietly. He will not even have time to be pompous about it.
hud_line: Take down an unaware human from behind — one silent, committed animation, but the body still talks if a guard finds it. Hold E.

Name: Prompts_06_FirstSightCivilianBind
overlord_bark: No. Not a body. Bodies pay me nothing. Rope him — I want them walking.
hud_line: Bind a civilian instead of killing — the rope chain banks at the stones, worth far more than a 5-point kill. Hold E (long).

Name: Prompts_07_FirstSightLivestockPen
overlord_bark: That is not a pig, goblin. That is forty points with trotters. Shoulder it.
hud_line: Steal a live pig instead of killing it — 40 loot points, and loot banks permanently the instant it reaches the runic site. Hold E to carry.

Name: Prompts_08_FirstSightWarHorn
overlord_bark: Blow it, and the treeline answers. Blow it early, and you will have all raid to regret it.
hud_line: Blow the war-horn to end the quiet half — 3–4 goblins sprint in per blast, 10 active, from a raid pool of 20. Press G.

Name: Prompts_09_FirstSightCourier
overlord_bark: Let the little one do the walking. You have arson pending.
hud_line: Point a horde goblin at a pig or a dropped loot sack — it couriers the cargo home, banks it permanently, then rejoins the summonable pool. One context command: Point.
